# 1. Load curatedMetagenomicData

```{r}

library(curatedMetagenomicData)
library(dplyr)

# Filter for infant stool samples
infant_samples <- sampleMetadata |>
  filter(body_site == "stool",
         age < 1)

# Show unique studies that contain infant stool samples
infant_titles <- infant_samples |>
  select(study_name, body_site, age) |>
  distinct()

infant_titles
```

```{r}

# Pull all infant stool datasets
infant_data <- curatedMetagenomicData(
  infant_titles$study_name,
  dryrun = TRUE
)

infant_data
```

```{r}

library(purrr)

infant_dryrun <- map(
  infant_titles$study_name,
  ~ curatedMetagenomicData(.x, dryrun = TRUE)
)

names(infant_dryrun)

infant_dryrun[[2]]
```

```{r}

best_dataset <- "BackhedF_2015"

infant_data <- curatedMetagenomicData(best_dataset, dryrun = FALSE)
```

```{r}

infant_data
```

```{r}

infant_data[[1]]
```

# 2. Tidy & Join Metadata

```{r}

rel_abund <- infant_data[["2021-10-14.BackhedF_2015.relative_abundance"]]

meta <- as.data.frame(colData(rel_abund)) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

abund_df <- as.data.frame(assay(rel_abund, "relative_abundance")) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -feature,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )

infant_tidy <- abund_df |>
  left_join(meta, by = "sample_id")
```

# 3. Metadata Exploration

```{r}

# Preview of first few rows & column header list

head(meta)

names(meta)
```

```{r}

# Count of samples by delivery mode

meta |> 
  count(born_method) |> 
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}

# Count of samples by feeding type

meta |> 
  count(feeding_practice) |> 
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}

# Count of samples by antibiotic exposure

meta |> 
  count(antibiotics_current_use) |> 
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}

# Age distribution 

meta |> 
  summarize(
    min_age = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age = max(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}

# Number of samples per subject

meta |> 
  count(subject_id) |> 
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}

# Total number of samples

nrow(meta)
```

```{r}

# Filter to infants only

meta_infants <- meta |>
  filter(age_category != "adult") |>
  filter(!grepl("_mo$", subject_id))
```

```{r}

# Number of samples in filtered table

nrow(meta_infants)
```

# 4. Alpha Diversity

```{r}

# Filter abundance table to infant samples only

infant_abund <- infant_tidy |>
  filter(sample_id %in% meta_infants$sample_id)
```

```{r}

# Alpha diversity (AD) metrics

library(vegan)
library(dplyr)

alpha_df <- infant_abund |>
  group_by(sample_id) |>
  summarize(
    shannon = diversity(abundance, index = "shannon"),
    simpson = diversity(abundance, index = "simpson"),
    richness = n_distinct(feature[abundance > 0])
  ) |>
  left_join(meta_infants, by = "sample_id")
```

```{r}

# Dataframe preview

head(alpha_df)
```

```{r}

# AD by delivery mode

alpha_df |>
  filter(!is.na(born_method)) |>
  group_by(born_method) |>
  summarize(
    mean_shannon = mean(shannon),
    mean_simpson = mean(simpson),
    mean_richness = mean(richness),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}

# AD by feeding method

alpha_df |>
  filter(!is.na(feeding_practice)) |>
  group_by(feeding_practice) |>
  summarize(
    mean_shannon = mean(shannon),
    mean_simpson = mean(simpson),
    mean_richness = mean(richness),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}

# AD by antibiotics exposure

alpha_df |>
  filter(!is.na(antibiotics_current_use)) |>
  group_by(antibiotics_current_use) |>
  summarize(
    mean_shannon = mean(shannon),
    mean_simpson = mean(simpson),
    mean_richness = mean(richness),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}

# Plot shannon diversity (SD) by delivery mode

library(ggplot2)

alpha_df |>
  filter(!is.na(born_method)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = born_method, y = shannon, fill = born_method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Shannon Diversity by Delivery Mode",
    x = "Delivery Mode",
    y = "Shannon Diversity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("results/figures/alpha_shannon_delivery.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

# Plot SD by feeding practice
```

```{r}

# Extract timepoints

alpha_df <- alpha_df |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      grepl("_B$", sample_id) ~ "Birth",
      grepl("_4M$", sample_id) ~ "4 Months",
      grepl("_12M$", sample_id) ~ "12 Months",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

alpha_df |> count(timepoint)
```

```{r}

# SD by delivery mode at each timepoint

alpha_df |>
  filter(!is.na(born_method), !is.na(timepoint)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = born_method, y = shannon, fill = born_method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Shannon Diversity by Delivery Mode Across Timepoints",
    x = "Delivery Mode",
    y = "Shannon Diversity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave("results/figures/shannon_delivery_timepoint.png", width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
